name: upstream-lean baseline: both measured technical holds remain waiting
due technical holds release once through the existing watcher and retain owner evidence
money, credentials, people, client words, production, accounts, taste, mixed asks and human endpoints remain held
interrupted answers, releases and reconciliations preserve recorded words and reject rerouting
a genuinely new hold routes once while preserving historical field-like decision words
unreadable backlog preserves pending work; confirmed zero-retention archival retires it
transport and unhold failures retain supervision and retry without duplicate delivery
changed reasons and explicit deferral prevent routing; a routing error still permits scheduled checks
